result.summary: No critical blockers are visible, but the page has a likely duplicate-content bug in the “Fastest near you” carousel and a few minor visual/accessibility concerns around clipped carousel content and low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: The first two “Fastest near you” cards appear to be exact duplicates: same “Green Bowl Poké” name, same bowl image, same 15–25 min ETA, and same €0.90 delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Check the data source and rendering logic for duplicated restaurant entries; ensure each card maps to a unique restaurant or clearly label variants if intentional.

issues.description: The rightmost visible “Fastest near you” card is cut off mid-name (“Smash Bros Bu…”) at the screen edge, which can look broken even if it is meant to indicate horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance such as peek spacing, scroll indicator, snap alignment, or ensure truncation uses ellipsis rather than hard clipping.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and restaurant details uses light gray text that may be difficult to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast guidance while preserving the visual hierarchy.
